title: The seat gateway lets tracy-web's signed POST /api/tracy-add-site/hold through to the add-site plugin, so Remove of an unfinished import and the abandoned-import sweep reach the host; every other unlisted add-site path and verb is still refused
steps: S1: Through the real dsh-passwords gateway with a stub dsh behind it, a seat shaped like the onboarding seat (home folder, no session, no upload grant) sends POST /api/tracy-add-site/hold with a JSON body and the three x-seat-* signature headers.
S2: The same seat sends GET /api/tracy-add-site/hold, POST /api/tracy-add-site/holds and POST /api/tracy-add-site/hold/forget.
expect: S1: the stub dsh receives the request with the body byte-for-byte and all three x-seat-* headers; the gateway does not answer 403 gw.adminOnly.
S2: each is refused with 403 before dsh hears of it.
evidence: Re-test on the dev machine (cowork.tracy.site), 22/10/2026, develop 7cdf942264: Remove on an unfinished import always showed 'could not remove… right now'; the API answered 503 HOST_UNAVAILABLE because the gateway refused tracy-web's signed hold call with 403 gw.adminOnly (route missing from SEAT_PLUGIN_ROUTES). REG-PR-1598's fence listed 'a real dsh gateway passing the signed hold call through' as not shown.
fence: The real gateway code against a stub dsh, the host half's signature check is covered by REG-PR-1598 S10. Not shown: Remove on the dev machine with a rebuilt dsh image (checked by hand after the merge), the cron's hourly timer.
